I like my life very much. Tom drinks milk every morning. We often go to the library together. In fact, there are forty desks in our classroom.
Tom and Lily are in the same class. The school garden is big and clean. Lily likes salad too. Also, my brother goes to college in Shanghai.
We talk about English a lot. Tom's favorite season is spring. The teachers' office is my favorite place.
